text:
jen.sales: Need a 5-day POC key for Orbita. GH Actions + local dev. Can we provision today?

 tom.se: Yes. We'll create a scoped key (generate + embeddings), TTL=120h, owner=jen.sales. Secret will be placed in Secrets Manager at secret://orbita/poc/key.

 jen.sales: They also asked in the questionnaire for audit logs and a simple revoke flow.

 tom.se: Audit logs enabled, retention=90d. Revoke (admin API):
 curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/admin/keys/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"key_id":"tok-orbita-poc-2026-01"}'

 tom.se: Console revoke: Admin > API Keys > search "tok-orbita-poc-2026-01" > Revoke. Revocation is immediate.

 maria.cs: Please add owner email (jen.sales@redwood.com) in metadata and schedule a 48h expiry reminder to CS. Also include rotation instructions for their security contact.

 tom.se: Done: owner=jen.sales@redwood.com; 48h reminder scheduled. ops-bot: Created key tok-orbita-poc-2026-01, TTL=120h, scope=[generate,embeddings], secret=secret://orbita/poc/key, audit_retention=90d.

 jen.sales: I'll send the onboarding email. Can you add a quick smoke test they can run?

 tom.se: Smoke test (curl):
 curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $ORB_POC_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","input":"hello"}'

 maria.cs: Rotation note: manual rotation for POC: create new key, update the secret in Secrets Manager or GH repo secret, run smoke test, then revoke the old key. Recommend Secrets Manager pull for production to enable automated rotation.

 jen.sales: Awesome, thanks. Closing this thread unless Orbita asks for auto-rotation or IP allowlist (both add ops work).
